description: This file implements a thread-safe singleton in-memory datastore with JSON persistence for TestCase and TestRun entities, including CRUD operations and disk loading/saving.

classes.name: _Singleton
classes.description: Metaclass implementing a thread-safe singleton pattern.

classes.name: Datastore
